## The Astral Omen

A flicker crossed the sky when paths entwined,<br />
Two orbits met, but one stayed behind.<br />
A silent wager, lost in the toss,<br />
Leaving one adrift, emotions crossed.<br />

Far it traveled since that quiet phase,<br />
Yet one still drifts in distant haze.<br />
The climb feels hollow in empty space,<br />
As one moves farther from the other's embrace.<br />

Its pull remains, a tranquil trace,<br />
Thoughts circling, left in place.<br />
The echoes heard, though faint and thin,<br />
Still linger in the air, within.<br />

When one drifts, a subtle shift,<br />
The other stirs, a heavy rift.<br />
No pause to see the weight it keeps,<br />
While one remains, and silence seeps.<br />

The sky bends softly around its glow,<br />
But never does it truly know.<br />
The balance tips, the shadows fall,<br />
As sleepless nights stretch long and tall.<br />

It sees itself a shining star,<br />
While the other chases from afar.<br />
Each step a dance, a quiet strain,<br />
This cosmic pull, an endless chain.<br />

Yet stars once bright, in distant light,<br />
Perhaps were <strong>never truly bright</strong>.
